consumer_call_path: CpfFileLogWriter append failure -> recoverySpool.enqueue -> startup/next-append/close replay
reproduction: Inspect listed exact-SHA source and run the stated verification gate/fault test.
expected: Durable spool survives process/container restart and retries autonomously with backoff until replay/quarantine/terminal-loss handling.
actual: Default spool root is java.io.tmpdir; replay is driven only at writer startup, next append, or close. Hard kill skips close; ephemeral tmp storage may be lost; after startup a failed replay has no autonomous retry if no further write occurs.
risk: File log loss or indefinite stranded spool in precisely the process-kill/disk-recovery cases the requirement covers.
root_cause: Durability location and retry scheduling are not lifecycle-owned as a persistent recovery subsystem.
required_fix: Use explicitly durable managed spool root, background bounded retry scheduler/lease, restart scan, shutdown drain, terminal alert, and corruption/partial-write handling.
verification: Hard-kill + restart + no-new-write test, disk-full/read-only recovery, corrupt spool quarantine, duplicate replay and terminal-loss metrics.
